boundary.en: Synthetic teaching preset controlled only by the simulator; not a measured sample spectrum.
boundary.zh: 仅由模拟器控制的合成教学预设，不是实测样品谱图。

notes.en: A synthetic analog of a classic bright dye; tune near green excitation and orange emission.
notes.zh: 经典明亮染料的合成类比；可在绿色激发与橙色发射附近观察。

feedback.en: Rhodamine 6G-like dye preset: synthetic analog, best viewed near Ex 530 nm and Em 560 nm; the cited R6G source-derived spectrum remains display-only.
feedback.zh: 罗丹明 6G 类染料预设：合成类比样品，适合在 Ex 530 nm 与 Em 560 nm 附近观察；引用的 R6G 来源谱仍仅用于显示。
